steps.title: Define App Specifications
steps.description: Initialize specifications for Notes Keeper including package name com.noteskeeper.app.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Set application parameters, register MainActivity with launcher category, and map proper theme and icon paths.

steps.title: Set up Gradle Build Settings
steps.description: Configure app/build.gradle script targeting Android SDK version 34 and Java 8 compiler compatibility levels.

steps.title: Establish Note Model Structure
steps.description: Create Note.java model representing structured note objects with IDs, titles, content, dynamic categories, and timestamps.

steps.title: Create Database Schema Helper
steps.description: Implement DatabaseHelper.java based on Android SQLiteOpenHelper framework to create notes table and manage standard records.

steps.title: Design Note Row Interface Layout
steps.description: Construct note_item.xml layout representing notes inside dynamic list view displaying title, truncated body, and date.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Screen Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml carrying dual screen templates for browsing list with dynamic search input filters and custom editors.

steps.title: Code View Initializations
steps.description: Establish MainActivity view declarations mapping text input views, list managers, spinners, buttons, and custom layout views.

steps.title: Implement SQL Query Fetch Methods
steps.description: Program custom database filter routines capable of matching dynamic search bar entries and spinner categories simultaneously.

steps.title: Create Custom Notes ListView Adapter
steps.description: Develop inner NotesAdapter in MainActivity to translate note items into list elements mapped with standard views.

steps.title: Implement Search TextWatcher Dynamic Filtering
steps.description: Hook TextWatcher listeners to search bar to dynamically re-query SQLite database and update list with matching items.

steps.title: Design Dynamic Spinner Category Selectors
steps.description: Bind item select callbacks to filter spinner and populate list according to selected custom category query parameters.

steps.title: Create Editor Mode Navigation Toggle
steps.description: Develop view toggle logic switches between list view state and note creation form state carrying prefilled values on edit requests.

steps.title: Code Safe Note Saving Routine
steps.description: Implement content verification logic that processes both new notes creation inserts and existing notes updates on database.

steps.title: Develop Secure Delete Action Dialog
steps.description: Implement alert dialog confirmation and note cancellation sequences executing safe deletions of selected notes.

steps.title: Validate Clean Native Back Navigation
steps.description: Implement customized onBackPressed sequence prioritizing note edit mode exit transitions over full activity dismissal.

steps.title: Building Notes Keeper
steps.description: Perform full gradle build validation routine to compile and assemble the final Notes Keeper application bundle.
